summary: The Discord Battleground Dungeon is the warfront nexus of Discord. Endless battles rage between War‑Shades, Muramite legions, and Discord constructs. Collapse energy fuels the battlefield, creating a perpetual war zone.
history: Formed when Discord energy ruptured the battlefront.
War‑Shades established command posts across the battlefield.
Muramite legions clashed with Discord constructs endlessly.
Collapse energy amplified the conflict into perpetual war.
The Warfront Overlord manifested as embodiment of Discord battle.
